description: Analyze Manglik (Mangal dosha), Kaal Sarpa, and Sade Sati indicators for supplied birth data. Returns structured calculations, not deterministic life outcomes. Use city, region and country for a place. If a place is not found, ask the user to clarify it before trying another tool with the same place. Use only verified latitude and longitude; never guess coordinates.

date.description: Local birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Ask the user if it is unclear; do not infer it.

latitude.description: Verified latitude from -90 to 90, supplied with longitude. Never guess coordinates.

longitude.description: Verified longitude from -180 to 180, supplied with latitude. Never guess coordinates.

place.description: Birth city, region and country. Ask for clarification if unresolved before retrying in any tool. Do not silently substitute a different location.

time.description: Local birth time in 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format, without a UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, or omit to derive it from the verified birth location.

name: analyze_doshas
title: Analyze Vedic doshas
